hints.title: How to read the current encoder position
hints.content: Use `int currentPosition = testMotor.getCurrentPosition();` to read the encoder value. In this simulation, it returns 200.

hints.title: How to calculate error
hints.content: Error is simply `target - current`. With a target of 1000 and current position of 200, the error is 800.

hints.title: How to calculate proportional power
hints.content: Multiply Kp by the error: `double power = Kp * error;`. With Kp = 0.001 and error = 800, the power is 0.8.

hints.title: Putting it all together
hints.content: Three steps: (1) `int currentPosition = testMotor.getCurrentPosition();` (2) `double error = targetPosition - currentPosition;` (3) `double power = Kp * error;` then `testMotor.setPower(power);`
